DFB-Pokalfinale |trans-title="Absolute highlight": Jablonski officiates 83rd DFB-Pokal final |website=DFB.de |publisher=[[German Football Association]] |date=11 May 2026 |access-date=11 May 2026 |language=de}} | attendance = 74,036 | weather = | previous = [[2025 DFB-Pokal final|2025]] | next = ''2027'' }} The '''2026 DFB-Pokal final''' decided the winner of the [[2025–26 DFB-Pokal]], the 83rd season of the annual German [[Association football|football]] cup competition. The match was played on 23 May 2026 at the [[Olympiastadion (Berlin)|Olympiastadion]] in [[Berlin]].{{cite web |url=https://www.dfb.de/dfb-pokal/statistik/bisherige-sieger/ |title=Alle DFB-Pokalsieger |trans-title=All DFB-Pokal winners |website=DFB.de |publisher=[[German Football Association]] |date=21 May 2016 |access-date=6 June 2016 |language=German}}{{cite news |url=https://www.dfl.de/de/aktuelles/rahmenterminkalender-fur-die-saison-2025-26/|title=Rahmenterminkalender für die Saison 2025/26: Bundesliga-Auftakt am 22. August 2025 – 2. Bundesliga startet am 1. August 2025|website=DFB.de |publisher=[[German Football Association]] |date=8 November 2024|access-date=8 November 2024|language=de}} The match featured [[FC Bayern Munich|Bayern Munich]], record 20-time winners of the competition, and [[VfB Stuttgart]], the defending champions. Bayern Munich won the match 3–0, thanks to [[Harry Kane]]'s second half [[flawless hat-trick]] or ''lupenreiner'', a hat-trick uninterrupted by half-time or goals by other players.{{cite web |url=https://www.derstandard.at/story/3000000321959/bayern-holt-mit-30-im-dfb-cup-finale-das-double |title=Bayern holt mit 3:0 im DFB-Cup-Finale das Double |language=German |trans-title= Bayern Munich win the double with a 3–0 victory in the DFB Cup final |website=Der Standard |date=23 May 2026 |access-date=24 May 2026 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260524151953/https://www.derstandard.at/consent/tcf/story/3000000321959/bayern-holt-mit-30-im-dfb-cup-finale-das-double |archive-date=24 May 2026}}{{cite web|url= https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/401862315|title= Harry Kane hits hat-trick, 61st goal of season as Bayern see off Stuttgart in German Cup final|date=23 May 2026|work=ESPN|accessdate=25 May 2026}} It was Bayern's 21st DFB-Pokal title and the win completed a domestic [[Double (association football)|double]]; they will therefore face [[2025–26 Bundesliga|Bundesliga]] runners-up [[Borussia Dortmund]] in the [[2026 Franz Beckenbauer Supercup]]. Furthermore, since Bayern already qualified for the [[2026–27 UEFA Champions League|Champions League]] through the Bundesliga, the sixth-placed team in the Bundesliga, [[Bayer 04 Leverkusen|Bayer Leverkusen]], earned qualification for the group stage of the [[2026–27 UEFA Europa League]], and the play-off round spot of the [[2026–27 UEFA Conference League]] went to the team in seventh, [[SC Freiburg]].{{cite news |url=http://www.uefa.org/about-uefa/executive-committee/news/newsid=1999120.html |title=Strategic talks in Dubrovnik |website=UEFA.org |publisher=[[UEFA|Union of European Football Associations]] |date=20 September 2013 |access-date=29 April 2015}} ==Teams== ''In the following table, finals until 1943 were in the Tschammerpokal era, since 1953 were in the DFB-Pokal era.'' {| class="wikitable" |- ! There were a total of five rounds leading up to the final. Teams were drawn against each other, and the winner after 90 minutes would advance. If still tied, 30 minutes of [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] was played. If the score was still level, a [[Penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] was used to determine the winner.{{cite web |url=https://www.dfb.de/dfb-pokal/modus/ |title=Modus |trans-title=Mode |website=DFB.de |publisher=[[German Football Association]] |date=15 August 2012 |access-date=11 June 2015 |language=German}} ''Note: In all results below, the score of the finalist is given first (H: home; A: away).'' {| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center; white-space:nowrap;" |- ! colspan="2" | [[FC Bayern Munich|Bayern Munich]] !
